title: A Penalty Goes a Long Way: Measuring Lexical Diversity in Synthetic Texts Under Prompt-Influenced Length Variations
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a new metric for lexical diversity (PATTR) and specifically addresses technical 'length bias' in evaluation metrics for LLM outputs. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics; the inclusion of an 'Ethical Considerations' section is a procedural requirement and not the focus of the research.
